courses.title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
courses.summary: 從機翼載荷、複材方向、公差鏈到配置變更，用原創示意與紙上算例學習A350類客機的系統整合。
courses.summaryEn: Study A350-class airliner integration through original sketches and paper exercises on wing loads, composite directionality, tolerance chains and configuration change.
courses.scope: 12道入門工程學習任務；引用A350公開背景，力學數值為明示教學假設。不是原廠鋪層表、裝配SOP、維修手冊、適航符合性證明或製造授權。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve introductory engineering tasks grounded in public A350 background, with explicitly hypothetical mechanics values. Not manufacturer layup schedules, assembly SOPs, maintenance instructions, airworthiness substantiation or manufacturing authorization.

stages.title: 需求、載荷與基準
stages.description: 先定義系統邊界，再用質量、力矩及座標建立可追溯的整合問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Define boundaries, then use mass, moments and coordinates to establish traceable integration questions.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 分配客機系統邊界
steps.objective: 把機體、動力、供電與控制的介面分開記錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate interfaces among airframe, propulsion, power and control.
steps.instruction: 在紙上畫四個系統方塊，分別用實線、虛線表示載荷與資訊交換。以A350公開介紹辨識用途，再為每條箭頭寫下輸入、輸出與責任者；圖是你的原創示意。
steps.instructionEn: Draw four system blocks, using solid and dashed arrows for loads and information. Identify purposes from the public A350 overview, then label each interface with its input, output and owner. This is your own schematic.
steps.observation: 觀察一條電源線與一項結構支承是否被錯當成同一種介面。
steps.observationEn: Check whether an electrical supply and a structural support have been treated as the same interface.
steps.failure: 只列零件名稱而沒有交換量，會隱藏整合問題。
steps.failureEn: A parts list without exchanged quantities hides integration problems.
steps.check: 至少列出一項機械、一項電力及一項資訊介面，各有可檢查的量。
steps.checkEn: Identify mechanical, electrical and information interfaces, each with a checkable quantity.

knowledge.title: 功能與實體
knowledge.text: 一個功能可能跨越多個實體零件；方塊邊界是分析選擇。
knowledge.textEn: One function may span several physical parts; block boundaries are analytical choices.

knowledge.title: 介面責任
knowledge.text: 輸出符合自己的規格，仍須與接收端假設相容。
knowledge.textEn: Meeting an output specification still requires compatibility with the receiving side.

quiz.question: 兩團隊零件各自合格，整合卻失敗，先查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two teams pass their component checks but integration fails. What should be checked first?
options: 只確認各零件單獨合格即可接受整合
只核對總質量是否與原計畫相同
介面的交換量與假設是否一致
optionsEn: Accept integration as soon as the individual parts pass
Check only whether total mass matches the original plan
Whether exchanged quantities and interface assumptions agree
quiz.explanation: 局部合格不自動證明跨系統相容。
quiz.explanationEn: Local compliance does not automatically establish system compatibility.

steps.title: 計算示意配重的重心
steps.objective: 以位置加權理解配置變更對重心的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Use position-weighted mass to understand configuration changes.
steps.instruction: 設兩個教學質量：2單位位於x=1，1單位位於x=4。算總質量與重心，再把後者移到x=7重算；所有數值均為無因次例題，不是飛機限制。
steps.instructionEn: Use teaching masses of 2 units at x=1 and 1 unit at x=4. Calculate total mass and center of mass, then move the latter to x=7 and recalculate. All values are dimensionless examples, not aircraft limits.
steps.observation: 總質量不變，重心卻由2移到3。
steps.observationEn: Total mass stays constant while the center moves from 2 to 3.
steps.failure: 直接平均兩個位置，等於錯把不同質量視為相等。
steps.failureEn: Averaging positions directly wrongly assigns equal weight to unequal masses.
steps.check: 保留兩次力矩和，並用總質量除回重心。
steps.checkEn: Retain both moment sums and divide by total mass to recover the center.

knowledge.title: 一階質量矩
knowledge.text: 重心由Σmx／Σm求得，必須使用共同原點。
knowledge.textEn: The center is Σmx/Σm, using a common origin.

knowledge.title: 配置管理
knowledge.text: 搬動設備可能改變重心，即使沒有新增重量。
knowledge.textEn: Relocating equipment can change balance without adding mass.

quiz.question: 把同一設備往後移，哪項必然不變？
quiz.questionEn: When the same item is moved aft, which quantity necessarily stays unchanged?
options: 重心位置
總質量
總質量矩
optionsEn: Center-of-mass position
Total mass
Total mass moment
quiz.explanation: 位置改變影響力矩，不改變該設備質量。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing position alters the moment, not the item’s mass.

steps.title: 追蹤機翼到機身的載荷路徑
steps.objective: 區分分布載荷、接合處反力與局部應力。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish distributed load, joint reaction and local stress.
steps.instruction: 畫一根固定端示意樑，把三支向上箭頭分布在翼展上。先令總力相同，再把箭頭外移；比较固定端彎矩。僅做紙上力學，不推算真機強度。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a fixed-end teaching beam with three upward arrows along its span. Keep total force unchanged, move the arrows outward and compare root bending moments. Use paper mechanics only, without inferring aircraft strength.
steps.observation: 相同升力總和，作用點更遠時根部力矩增加。
steps.observationEn: The same total lift produces a larger root moment when applied farther out.
steps.failure: 只比較總力會漏掉力臂，接頭也不能用外觀大小判定安全。
steps.failureEn: Comparing total force alone misses the lever arm; joint appearance cannot establish safety.
steps.check: 每支箭頭標出到根部的距離，列出ΣFr。
steps.checkEn: Label each lever arm and calculate ΣFr.

knowledge.title: 力臂
knowledge.text: 力矩取決於力與其垂直作用距離。
knowledge.textEn: Moment depends on force and its perpendicular lever arm.

knowledge.title: 局部與整體
knowledge.text: 整體平衡提供反力，局部接頭仍需獨立驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Global equilibrium gives reactions; local joints still require separate substantiation.

quiz.question: 總升力不變、向翼尖移動，根部彎矩如何變化？
quiz.questionEn: With total lift unchanged but moved toward the tip, how does root bending moment change?
options: 增大
必定降為零
因總力相同而不變
optionsEn: It increases
It necessarily becomes zero
It is unchanged because total force is unchanged
quiz.explanation: 外移增加力臂，因此增加根部力矩。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving the load outward increases its lever arm and root moment.

steps.title: 核對裝配基準與公差鏈
steps.titleEn: Check assembly datums and tolerance chains
steps.objective: 讓兩個分段使用一致的座標與驗收基準。
steps.objectiveEn: Give two sections consistent coordinates and acceptance datums.
steps.instruction: 在兩張原創機身分段圖標出共同原點、軸向和接合平面。假設兩段偏差各為±0.4示意單位，求最壞相對錯位，再與假設允收±0.6比較。
steps.instructionEn: Mark a shared origin, axes and mating plane on two original fuselage-section sketches. Assume each has an error of ±0.4 teaching units. Find the worst relative mismatch and compare with an assumed ±0.6 allowance.
steps.observation: 單段各自合格，反向偏差仍可能造成0.8錯位。
steps.observationEn: Individually acceptable sections can still mismatch by 0.8 when errors oppose.
steps.failure: 混用機身座標與局部治具座標，會產生看似固定的系統偏差。
steps.failureEn: Mixing body and fixture frames can create an apparently fixed systematic offset.
steps.check: 指出最壞組合，且圖上所有尺寸可追溯到相同基準。
steps.checkEn: Identify the worst combination and trace every dimension to the common datum.

knowledge.title: 基準
knowledge.text: 尺寸的意義依賴其參考平面與方向。
knowledge.textEn: A dimension depends on its reference plane and direction.

knowledge.title: 公差累積
knowledge.text: 最壞相對誤差需考慮兩零件朝相反方向偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Worst relative error includes opposite deviations of the two parts.

quiz.question: 兩段各±0.4，最壞相對錯位是多少？
quiz.questionEn: For two sections each at ±0.4, what is the worst relative mismatch?
quiz.explanationEn: One at +0.4 and the other at −0.4 differ by 0.8.

stages.title: 材料回應與損傷證據
stages.description: 比较方向性、熱相容、檢測範圍與循環載荷；不替代任何實機材料試驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare directionality, thermal compatibility, inspection scope and cyclic loading without replacing aircraft material tests.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 辨識複材方向性
steps.objective: 把纖維方向與載荷方向連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate fiber direction to loading direction.
steps.instruction: 畫三張試片示意：纖維沿0°、90°及混合方向。對同一軸向拉力標出纖維與基材可能扮演的角色；只提出待測假設，不自填材料強度。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch coupons with fibers at 0°, 90° and mixed orientations. Under the same axial load, identify possible fiber and matrix roles. Record hypotheses requiring tests instead of inventing strength values.
steps.observation: 旋轉試片方向會改變材料回應，即使外形與厚度相同。
steps.observationEn: Rotating the material direction can alter response despite identical shape and thickness.
steps.failure: 把複材當作各方向相同的金屬，會掩蓋方向性與層間問題。
steps.failureEn: Treating a laminate as direction-independent metal hides anisotropy and interlaminar issues.
steps.check: 每張試片都有載荷箭頭、纖維方向及一項待驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Each coupon shows a load arrow, fiber orientation and a testable hypothesis.

knowledge.title: 異向性
knowledge.text: 複材性質可能隨方向改變，不能只用單一強度數字描述。
knowledge.textEn: Composite properties can vary by direction and cannot be described by one strength value alone.

knowledge.title: 基材功能
knowledge.text: 基材保持纖維配置並傳遞載荷，不能視為無功能的填充物。
knowledge.textEn: The matrix maintains fiber arrangement and transfers load; it is not an inert filler.

quiz.question: 兩試片外形一樣卻反應不同，哪項應優先核對？
quiz.questionEn: Two equal-shaped coupons respond differently. Which factor should be checked first?
options: 只比較外形與厚度是否相同
纖維方向與鋪層資訊
只核對總質量，不看鋪層
optionsEn: Compare only external shape and thickness
Fiber orientation and laminate information
Check only mass without examining the layup
quiz.explanation: 方向與鋪層直接影響複材力學回應。
quiz.explanationEn: Orientation and layup directly affect composite mechanical response.

steps.title: 比較異材接合的熱伸長
steps.titleEn: Compare thermal expansion at a mixed-material joint
steps.objective: 理解相連材料自由伸長不同的後果。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand consequences of unequal free thermal expansion.
steps.instruction: 假設兩條等長教學材料的熱膨脹係數為2與10個相同單位，在相同升溫下比較自由伸長比。再畫出端部被共同約束的情境，列出需要分析的接頭反力。
steps.instructionEn: Assume equal-length teaching strips with expansion coefficients of 2 and 10 in the same units. Compare free expansion under equal heating, then sketch a shared end restraint and identify joint reactions needing analysis.
steps.observation: 較大係數的自由伸長為另一條的5倍；接合後不能各自自由伸長。
steps.observationEn: The higher-coefficient strip expands five times as much freely; joined strips cannot both follow their free expansion.
steps.failure: 把自由熱伸長直接當作受約束後的實際位移，忽略了相容条件。
steps.failureEn: Using free expansion as constrained displacement ignores compatibility.
steps.check: 分別列出自由伸長與約束後需解的未知量，不猜接頭應力值。
steps.checkEn: Separate free expansion from unknown constrained quantities without guessing joint stress.

knowledge.title: 熱應變
knowledge.text: 自由熱應變由膨脹係數乘溫度變化得到。
knowledge.textEn: Free thermal strain is expansion coefficient times temperature change.

knowledge.title: 相容條件
knowledge.text: 被接在一起的部位須同時滿足幾何相容與力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Connected parts must satisfy both geometric compatibility and force equilibrium.

quiz.question: 自由伸長不同的材料被接合後，還需加入什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What must be added when joining materials with different free expansions?
options: 約束與相容條件
把較小伸長直接刪掉
假設接頭永遠沒有反力
optionsEn: Restraints and compatibility conditions
Discard the smaller expansion
Assume the joint never develops a reaction
quiz.explanation: 接頭限制相對移動，可能因此產生內力。
quiz.explanationEn: The joint limits relative movement and can generate internal forces.

steps.title: 建立複材檢查的證據地圖
steps.objective: 區分表面觀察與內部損傷的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish surface observation from internal-damage evidence.
steps.instruction: 畫一片有表面撞痕與假設層間缺陷的示意板。把目視、適用的非破壞檢測與後續工程評估放在不同欄位；為每種方法註明它能回答與不能回答的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a panel with a surface impact mark and a hypothetical internal defect. Separate visual inspection, applicable nondestructive inspection and engineering assessment into columns, stating what each can and cannot answer.
steps.observation: 外表平整不能排除內部異常，檢測訊號也不自動等於可放行。
steps.observationEn: A smooth surface cannot rule out internal anomalies, and a signal alone does not authorize release.
steps.failure: 用照片替代經核准的檢測與判讀，會把未知狀態誤標合格。
steps.failureEn: Substituting a photo for approved inspection and interpretation mislabels uncertainty as acceptance.
steps.check: 至少一項未知量保留為待確認，並列出需要的合格判讀證據。
steps.checkEn: Retain at least one unresolved question and identify the qualified interpretation needed.

knowledge.title: 損傷容限
knowledge.text: 發現、評估和處置損傷是不同工作。
knowledge.textEn: Detecting, assessing and dispositioning damage are separate tasks.

knowledge.title: 檢測範圍
knowledge.text: 每種方法有適用材料、幾何與缺陷範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Every method has applicable materials, geometries and defect classes.

quiz.question: 沒有看見裂痕，能直接得出哪個結論？
quiz.questionEn: No crack is visible. Which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有內部層間皆完整
已符合真機放行要求
目前目視範圍沒有可見裂痕
optionsEn: All internal interfaces are intact
The aircraft release requirements are satisfied
No visible crack was found within the visual inspection scope
quiz.explanation: 證據只能支援其觀察範圍內的結論。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence supports conclusions only within its observation scope.

steps.title: 區分靜態強度與循環疲勞
steps.titleEn: Separate static strength from cyclic fatigue
steps.objective: 用載荷歷程而非一次峰值描述耐久問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Describe durability through load history rather than one peak.
steps.instruction: 自畫兩條無因次載荷曲線：一次峰值與多次較低振幅循環。標記循環數、平均值和振幅，列出需要何種試驗資料才能比較壽命；不自行推算服役年限。
steps.instructionEn: Draw dimensionless load histories: one peak and repeated lower-amplitude cycles. Mark cycle count, mean and amplitude, then identify test data needed to compare life. Do not infer service years.
steps.observation: 低於一次試驗峰值的循環載荷，仍可能累積損傷。
steps.observationEn: Repeated loading below a single-test peak can still accumulate damage.
steps.failure: 一次靜載通過就宣稱無限壽命，混淆了不同驗證目的。
steps.failureEn: Claiming unlimited life after one static pass confuses different verification purposes.
steps.check: 報告分開寫靜態判定、循環資料與尚未回答的壽命問題。
steps.checkEn: Report static assessment, cyclic data and unanswered life questions separately.

knowledge.title: 载荷歷程
knowledge.text: 疲勞問題包含次數、振幅、平均值與順序。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue problems include count, amplitude, mean and sequence.

knowledge.title: 驗證範圍
knowledge.text: 一種試驗合格不自動覆蓋所有失效機制。
knowledge.textEn: Passing one test does not cover every failure mechanism.

quiz.question: 靜載測試通過後，仍不能直接宣稱什麼？
quiz.questionEn: After passing a static test, what still cannot be claimed directly?
options: 仍需要辨識使用載荷歷程
已證明所有循環疲勞壽命
該靜載情境已取得一項證據
optionsEn: The service-load history still needs identification
Every cyclic-fatigue life requirement is proven
Evidence exists for that static-load case
quiz.explanation: 靜態與疲勞的驗證對象不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Static and fatigue verification address different behavior.

stages.title: 系統整合與配置交付
stages.description: 把冗餘、空間、變更及證據成熟度納入同一份工程紀錄。
stages.descriptionEn: Bring redundancy, space, change and evidence maturity into one engineering record.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 檢查冗餘電源的共同依賴
steps.titleEn: Check shared dependencies in redundant power
steps.objective: 避免把兩條線路誤認成兩套獨立供電。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid confusing two wires with two independent supplies.
steps.instruction: 畫两路教學電源供應同一感測器，先讓它們共用一個上游開關，再另畫分開的上游路徑。用紙上斷點逐一追蹤失效影響，不模擬真機電路。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two teaching supplies feeding one sensor, first sharing an upstream switch and then using separate upstream paths. Trace failures with paper break points, without simulating an aircraft circuit.
steps.observation: 共用開關失效可同時切斷兩條下游線路。
steps.observationEn: A shared switch failure can interrupt both downstream paths.
steps.failure: 只數備份元件，未檢查共同依賴，會高估可用性。
steps.failureEn: Counting backup components without shared-dependency analysis overstates availability.
steps.check: 標出至少一個共同失效點及其影響，將未知獨立性列為待驗證。
steps.checkEn: Mark a common failure point and its effect, retaining unproven independence as an open item.

knowledge.title: 共同原因
knowledge.text: 相同來源或環境可能同時影響看似分開的設備。
knowledge.textEn: A shared source or environment can affect apparently separate equipment.

knowledge.title: 失效傳播
knowledge.text: 系統邊界上的依賴決定故障如何擴散。
knowledge.textEn: Dependencies across boundaries determine how faults propagate.

quiz.question: 兩路電源共用上游開關，該開關失效代表什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two supplies share an upstream switch. What does its failure imply?
options: 兩路可能同時失去供電
必定只有一路受影響
下游有兩條線就不受影響
optionsEn: Both paths may lose power together
Only one path can be affected
Two downstream wires prevent any effect
quiz.explanation: 路徑數量不能取代獨立性分析。
quiz.explanationEn: Path count is not a substitute for independence analysis.

steps.title: 審查管線與維修可達性
steps.objective: 在原創配置圖上辨識跨系統的空間衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify cross-system spatial conflicts on an original layout.
steps.instruction: 畫一段機身設備艙示意，放入管線、線束、支承與可拆面板。先標運動及熱源區，再安排檢查視線和拆卸路徑；尺寸只用自訂教學單位。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a fuselage equipment bay with pipes, wiring, supports and a removable panel. Mark moving and hot zones, then inspection sightlines and removal paths. Use invented teaching units only.
steps.observation: 在安裝時放得進去，不代表日後能安全檢查或取出。
steps.observationEn: Fitting during installation does not ensure later inspection or removal access.
steps.failure: 只看靜止的正視圖，可能漏掉運動包络或拆卸空間。
steps.failureEn: A static front view may hide motion envelopes or removal clearances.
steps.check: 為一項元件畫出完整移出路徑，並列出至少一項介面衝突。
steps.checkEn: Draw a complete removal path for one item and identify an interface conflict.

knowledge.title: 維護設計
knowledge.text: 可達性是生命周期需求，不是完工後才處理的附加項。
knowledge.textEn: Access is a lifecycle requirement rather than an afterthought.

knowledge.title: 空間包络
knowledge.text: 位置、運動、工具與拆卸路徑佔用不同空間。
knowledge.textEn: Installed position, motion, tools and removal paths occupy different spaces.

quiz.question: 元件安裝後被固定管線擋住，主要漏了什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A fixed pipe blocks an installed component’s removal. What was omitted?
options: 只確認最初裝配時元件放得進去
只比較檢修口面積而不檢查移出路徑
維修拆卸的空間介面
optionsEn: Confirm only that the component fitted during initial assembly
Compare access-panel area without checking the removal path
The maintenance-removal spatial interface
quiz.explanation: 維修需要考慮整條拆卸路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance requires considering the entire removal path.

steps.title: 追蹤設計變更的影響鏈
steps.objective: 讓一項材料變更連回所有受影響的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect a material change to every affected evidence item.
steps.instruction: 設想教學支架由材料甲改為乙。建立變更卡，逐欄檢查質量、熱膨脹、接合、檢測方式及圖面版本；未知欄寫待確認，不自行批准替代。
steps.instructionEn: Imagine changing a teaching bracket from material A to B. Create a change card covering mass, thermal expansion, joining, inspection and drawing revision. Mark unknowns for review rather than approving substitution.
steps.observation: 外形相同的支架仍可能改變負載與檢驗需求。
steps.observationEn: An equal-shaped bracket may still change loads and inspection needs.
steps.failure: 只更新採購名稱而保留舊驗證結論，會切斷配置追溯。
steps.failureEn: Updating only the purchase name while keeping old verification breaks configuration traceability.
steps.check: 變更卡至少連到兩項需重新審查的既有證據。
steps.checkEn: Link the change card to at least two existing evidence items requiring review.

knowledge.title: 配置基線
knowledge.text: 驗證結果只對特定版本與假設成立。
knowledge.textEn: Verification results apply to a particular revision and assumptions.

knowledge.title: 變更影響
knowledge.text: 一項局部替換可能跨越結構、熱與維護介面。
knowledge.textEn: A local substitution may cross structural, thermal and maintenance interfaces.

quiz.question: 材料已更換、外形不變，舊驗證可以如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Material changes but shape does not. How should previous verification be treated?
options: 外形相同就自動沿用所有舊證據
先審查適用性與影響，再決定需重做部分
僅比較新舊材料密度，不審查其他介面
optionsEn: Automatically reuse every old result because shape is unchanged
Review applicability and impact before selecting re-verification
Compare only density without reviewing other interfaces
quiz.explanation: 外形一致不足以證明材料變更沒有影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal geometry does not establish that a material change has no effect.

steps.title: 組成分層驗證證據包
steps.objective: 把分析、試片、分系統與整合的證據分層。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate analysis, coupon, subsystem and integration evidence.
steps.instruction: 將前十一道工序的筆記排成矩陣，每列是一項需求，每欄是一種證據。明確標示教學推論、引用事實與尚缺測試；選一項接合需求追蹤到底。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange the previous eleven task notes in a matrix with requirements as rows and evidence types as columns. Mark teaching deductions, cited facts and missing tests. Trace one joint requirement through the layers.
steps.observation: 完整欄位不代表實際取得證據，空缺應維持可見。
steps.observationEn: A filled form does not mean evidence was obtained; gaps must remain visible.
steps.failure: 用漂亮模型截圖代替結構試驗或審查紀錄，會高估完成度。
steps.failureEn: Replacing structural tests or review records with attractive model screenshots overstates completion.
steps.check: 交付一條可追溯證據鏈，且沒有把本課程當作真機製造放行。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a traceable evidence chain without treating the course as an aircraft manufacturing release.

knowledge.title: 驗證階層
knowledge.text: 局部材料表現與整機整合是不同尺度的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Local material behavior and aircraft integration are different scales of problem.

knowledge.title: 證據成熟度
knowledge.text: 假設、計畫與已完成量測應有不同狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Assumptions, plans and completed measurements need distinct status labels.

quiz.question: 哪項最適合標為「待取得證據」？
quiz.questionEn: Which item should be marked as evidence still to obtain?
options: 已規劃但尚未執行的試驗
已引用並核對的公開首飛日期
已算出的教學重心例題
optionsEn: A planned but unperformed test
A checked and cited public first-flight date
A completed classroom center-of-mass calculation
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫不等於試驗結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A test plan is not a test result.

courses.title: Alvin 載人科學潛器
courses.summary: 以Alvin公開科學任務為背景，拆解浮力、縱傾、觀測幾何、樣本識別及資料驗證，理解深海研究平台如何服務科學問題。
courses.summaryEn: Use Alvin’s public science mission to study buoyancy, trim, viewing geometry, sample identity and data verification, linking an ocean platform to scientific questions.
courses.scope: 12道紙上與示意模型任務，數值均為明示教學假設；不提供耐壓艙設計、生命維持規格、載人試驗、真實下潛計畫或操作許可。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve paper and schematic-model tasks with explicitly hypothetical values. No pressure-hull design, life-support specifications, crewed tests, actual dive planning or operating authorization.

stages.title: 科學目的與靜力模型
stages.description: 把觀測需求連到壓差、浮力與力矩，區分平台功能與科學目的。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect observation needs to pressure difference, buoyancy and moments, separating platform function from science purpose.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 把科學問題轉成觀測需求
steps.titleEn: Turn a science question into observation requirements
steps.objective: 定義潛器要取得的資料，而非只列設備。
steps.objectiveEn: Define the required data rather than merely listing instruments.
steps.instruction: 設定虛構任務：比較兩處海底岩石外觀。列出影像、樣本識別、位置及時間四欄，說明每欄如何回答問題；不規劃真實下潛。
steps.instructionEn: Set a fictional mission comparing rock appearance at two seafloor sites. List imagery, sample identity, position and time, explaining how each answers the question. Do not plan an actual dive.
steps.observation: 缺少位置或樣本識別的照片，難以連回同一觀測對象。
steps.observationEn: A photograph without location or sample identity is difficult to connect to its observation target.
steps.failure: 把相機解析度當成整個任務成功標準，忽略資料脈絡。
steps.failureEn: Treating camera resolution as the entire success criterion ignores data context.
steps.check: 每項資料均對應科學問題，且有識別與時間欄位。
steps.checkEn: Each datum maps to the science question and has identity and time fields.

knowledge.title: 需求分配
knowledge.text: 科學目的必須轉成可收集、可追溯的資料。
knowledge.textEn: A scientific purpose must become collectible, traceable data.

knowledge.title: 任務邊界
knowledge.text: 教育案例只討論資料需求，不授權現場操作。
knowledge.textEn: The educational case addresses data requirements, not operational authorization.

quiz.question: 要把岩石照片與實體樣本對上，最缺不得的是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is essential for matching a rock photograph to its physical sample?
options: 只依相近拍攝時間猜測配對
只依容器擺放順序配對
共同樣本識別碼與記錄
optionsEn: Infer the pairing only from similar capture times
Match only by container placement order
A shared sample identifier and record
quiz.explanation: 共同識別碼維持影像與樣本間的關聯。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared identifier preserves the image-to-sample relationship.

steps.title: 區分水深與壓差
steps.objective: 用靜水概念標記外部與內部環境。
steps.objectiveEn: Use hydrostatics to label exterior and interior environments.
steps.instruction: 畫一個封閉教學球體，分別標示外部水壓及內部壓力。以p外=p表面+ρgh比較h與2h的水柱貢獻；保持ρ與g不變，不計算艙壁厚度。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a closed teaching sphere and label external and internal pressures. Use p_external=p_surface+ρgh to compare water-column contributions at h and 2h with constant density and gravity. Do not calculate wall thickness.
steps.observation: 加倍深度使水柱壓力項加倍，但不使含表面壓力的絕對壓力恰好加倍。
steps.observationEn: Doubling depth doubles the water-column term, not necessarily the absolute pressure including surface pressure.
steps.failure: 混用絕對壓力與壓差，會使載荷敘述不清。
steps.failureEn: Mixing absolute pressure with differential pressure obscures the load definition.
steps.check: 圖上同時標出內壓、外壓及兩者差，寫明模型假設。
steps.checkEn: Label internal, external and differential pressures and state the assumptions.

knowledge.title: 靜水壓力
knowledge.text: 在密度近似固定時，水柱壓力隨深度線性增加。
knowledge.textEn: With approximately constant density, water-column pressure grows linearly with depth.

knowledge.title: 壓差
knowledge.text: 結構兩側環境的差異決定相應載荷問題。
knowledge.textEn: The difference between environments on either side defines the corresponding load problem.

quiz.question: 將h變為2h，哪一項恰好加倍？
quiz.questionEn: When h becomes 2h, which term doubles exactly in this model?
options: 內部壓力必然
ρgh水柱項
所有絕對壓力
optionsEn: The internal pressure necessarily
The ρgh water-column term
Every absolute pressure
quiz.explanation: 表面壓力項不隨水深加倍。
quiz.explanationEn: The surface-pressure term does not double with depth.

steps.title: 建立浮力與重量帳
steps.titleEn: Build a buoyancy and weight balance
steps.objective: 以排水體積與總質量判斷淨垂直力。
steps.objectiveEn: Use displaced volume and total mass to determine net vertical force.
steps.instruction: 使用紙上假設ρ=1、g=1、排水體積V=12、質量m=10，算B−W。再加入3單位質量而不改體積，重新判讀；這不是Alvin的實際數值。
steps.instructionEn: Use paper assumptions ρ=1, g=1, displaced volume V=12 and mass m=10 to compute B−W. Add 3 mass units without changing volume and reassess. These are not Alvin’s actual values.
steps.observation: 初始淨力為+2，增加載重後變成−1。
steps.observationEn: The initial net force is +2 and becomes −1 after adding the load.
steps.failure: 用物體外觀大小代替實際排水體積，或漏算工具重量，都會改變判定。
steps.failureEn: Substituting apparent size for displaced volume or omitting tool mass changes the result.
steps.check: 兩種狀態各寫出浮力、重量與淨力符號。
steps.checkEn: Record buoyancy, weight and net-force sign for both states.

knowledge.title: 阿基米德原理
knowledge.text: 浮力等於排開流體的重量。
knowledge.textEn: Buoyancy equals the weight of displaced fluid.

knowledge.title: 載荷清單
knowledge.text: 新增樣本與工具會改變質量帳，未必等量增加排水體積。
knowledge.textEn: Samples and tools change mass without necessarily adding proportional displaced volume.

quiz.question: 此模型增加3單位質量後，淨力為何？
quiz.questionEn: After adding 3 mass units in this model, what is the net force?
options: −1，向下
+2，向上
0，必定中性
optionsEn: −1, downward
+2, upward
0, necessarily neutral
quiz.explanation: 浮力12不變，重量由10變13，淨力為−1。
quiz.explanationEn: Buoyancy stays 12 while weight becomes 13, giving −1.

steps.title: 用力矩理解縱傾
steps.objective: 分開判斷中性浮力與姿態平衡。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate neutral buoyancy from attitude balance.
steps.instruction: 画側視圖，讓總浮力與重量相等，但兩作用線前後錯開。標出可能的轉動方向，再將一個小教學載荷沿前後移動，觀察力矩符號如何改變。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a side view with equal buoyancy and weight but fore-aft separation of their lines of action. Mark the possible rotation, then move a small teaching load along the vehicle and examine the moment sign.
steps.observation: 垂直合力為零時，仍可能存在使潛器俯仰的力矩。
steps.observationEn: Zero vertical resultant can coexist with a pitching moment.
steps.failure: 只檢查重量等於浮力，不能證明姿態已平衡。
steps.failureEn: Checking weight equals buoyancy alone does not establish attitude equilibrium.
steps.check: 同時列出合力與合力矩兩個條件。
steps.checkEn: State both force and moment equilibrium conditions.

knowledge.title: 浮心與重心
knowledge.text: 兩者的相對位置影響姿態回應。
knowledge.textEn: Their relative locations influence attitude response.

knowledge.title: 力偶
knowledge.text: 大小相等、方向相反但作用線不同的力可形成力偶。
knowledge.textEn: Equal opposite forces on different lines can form a couple.

quiz.question: 浮力等於重量但作用線錯開，能否保證不轉動？
quiz.questionEn: If buoyancy equals weight but the lines differ, is no rotation guaranteed?
options: 能，合力零就足夠
只有相機關閉才不能
不能，還要檢查力矩
optionsEn: Yes; zero resultant force is sufficient
Only if the camera is off
No; moments must also be checked
quiz.explanation: 平移與轉動是不同平衡條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Translational and rotational equilibrium are separate conditions.

stages.title: 浮材、能量與取樣介面
stages.titleEn: Buoyancy material, energy and sampling interfaces
stages.description: 以公開功能介紹和原創案例，檢查材料、照明及工具的相互限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Use public functions and original examples to examine material, lighting and tool constraints.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 比較浮材的功能與限制
steps.objective: 區分低密度與環境耐受的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate low density from environmental qualification.
steps.instruction: 依WHOI公開介紹畫浮材、框架與附件的功能圖。對兩種假設材料建立密度、吸水或壓縮行為、固定介面三欄；沒有公開資料的格子保留未知，不提供配方。
steps.instructionEn: Use WHOI’s overview to sketch buoyancy material, frame and attachments. Compare two hypothetical materials by density, water uptake or compression behavior, and mounting interfaces. Leave unavailable data unknown and supply no formulation.
steps.observation: 材料在表面能浮，不足以證明深水環境中功能維持。
steps.observationEn: Floating at the surface does not prove retained function in a deep-water environment.
steps.failure: 把低密度視為唯一選材條件，会漏掉環境與連接需求。
steps.failureEn: Using low density as the sole criterion omits environment and attachment needs.
steps.check: 至少提出一項材料性能及一項固定介面需取得的驗證證據。
steps.checkEn: Identify evidence needed for one material property and one attachment interface.

knowledge.title: 功能分工
knowledge.text: 浮材提供浮力，框架與附件承擔不同的結構功能。
knowledge.textEn: Buoyancy material, frame and attachments perform different functions.

knowledge.title: 環境相容
knowledge.text: 性能需要連同環境及使用時間定義。
knowledge.textEn: Performance must be defined together with environment and duration.

quiz.question: 桌上浮水測試能直接證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: What can a tabletop flotation test directly establish?
options: 真實載人任務可用
該次表面條件下的浮水表現
所有深度下的耐久性
optionsEn: Suitability for an actual crewed mission
Flotation behavior under those surface conditions
Durability at every depth
quiz.explanation: 測試結論不能超出其條件。
quiz.explanationEn: A test conclusion cannot exceed its conditions.

steps.title: 編製科學設備能量預算
steps.objective: 區分功率需求與任務能量需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish power demand from mission energy demand.
steps.instruction: 用自訂例題：相機10W開2小時，燈30W開半小時。求總Wh，再加入一項待查的待機消耗；把未知量獨立列出，不宣稱已估算整艇續航。
steps.instructionEn: Use an invented example: a 10 W camera for two hours and a 30 W light for half an hour. Sum Wh and add an unknown standby term separately. Do not claim to have estimated vehicle endurance.
steps.observation: 相機用20Wh，燈用15Wh；高功率不一定意味較大總能耗。
steps.observationEn: The camera uses 20 Wh and the light 15 Wh; higher power need not mean higher total energy.
steps.failure: 把W直接相加當作Wh，或漏掉待機時間，會破壞能量帳。
steps.failureEn: Adding watts as if they were watt-hours or omitting standby time breaks the energy balance.
steps.check: 列出35Wh已知部分、未知待機項及單位。
steps.checkEn: Report the known 35 Wh subtotal, unknown standby term and units.

knowledge.title: 功與率
knowledge.text: 能量是功率對時間的累積。
knowledge.textEn: Energy accumulates power over time.

knowledge.title: 預算邊界
knowledge.text: 科學負載能量不等於全部系統能量。
knowledge.textEn: Science-payload energy is not total system energy.

quiz.question: 哪個设备在此例耗能較多？
quiz.questionEn: Which device uses more energy in this example?
options: 相機，20Wh
燈，因為30W較大
兩者相同
optionsEn: Camera, 20 Wh
Light, because 30 W is larger
They use the same energy
quiz.explanation: 必須同時考慮功率與使用時間。
quiz.explanationEn: Both power and duration matter.

steps.title: 安排照明與影像幾何
steps.objective: 理解照明方向與懸浮粒子對影像的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand lighting direction and suspended-particle effects.
steps.instruction: 畫相機、目標及兩個不同方向的燈位。用示意光線標出直接照明與可能回到鏡頭的散射路徑；比較目標對比與陰影，不把示意圖當作已取得的水下照片。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a camera, target and two lighting positions. Trace direct illumination and possible particle-scattered paths into the lens. Compare contrast and shadows without treating the diagram as acquired underwater photography.
steps.observation: 更多光不一定帶来更多可辨識細節，散射也可能增加。
steps.observationEn: More light does not necessarily reveal more detail; scattering may also increase.
steps.failure: 只提高亮度而不查光路，會把曝光與可辨識度混為一談。
steps.failureEn: Increasing brightness without checking geometry confuses exposure with interpretability.
steps.check: 在兩張圖上各標出一項改善及一項代價。
steps.checkEn: Mark one benefit and one trade-off on each diagram.

knowledge.title: 散射
knowledge.text: 水中粒子可把光送回相機，降低目標對比。
knowledge.textEn: Particles can scatter light back toward the camera and reduce target contrast.

knowledge.title: 幾何證據
knowledge.text: 影像判讀需要相機、光源與目標的相對位置。
knowledge.textEn: Image interpretation benefits from relative camera, source and target positions.

quiz.question: 燈變亮但目標更難辨識，合理的下一步是？
quiz.questionEn: The light is brighter but the target is harder to distinguish. What is a reasonable next step?
options: 只用相機的標稱像素數解釋影像品質
只繼續增加亮度，不檢查光路
檢查散射與照明幾何
optionsEn: Explain quality only from the camera pixel count
Continue increasing brightness without checking optical paths
Inspect scattering and lighting geometry
quiz.explanation: 亮度與有用影像資訊不是同一量。
quiz.explanationEn: Brightness and useful image information are not the same quantity.

steps.title: 檢查取樣工具的可達範圍
steps.objective: 把觀測視野、工具路徑與樣本容器接起來。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect viewing field, tool path and sample container.
steps.instruction: 用平面示意圖放置相機視野、兩節教學手臂、樣本與容器。画取樣前後的工具姿態，检查路径是否遮住視野或碰到其他設備；不使用真機關節設定。
steps.instructionEn: On a plan-view schematic, place a camera field, a two-link teaching arm, a sample and a container. Draw before/after tool poses and inspect obscured views or equipment intersections, without using real joint settings.
steps.observation: 端點能碰到樣本，不代表整段手臂路徑無衝突。
steps.observationEn: Reaching the sample with the endpoint does not prove the whole arm path is clear.
steps.failure: 忽略手臂中間連桿或樣本外形，會低估碰撞範圍。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring intermediate links or sample shape underestimates collision extent.
steps.check: 保留起點、過渡點及終點三個姿態，皆核對視野與空間。
steps.checkEn: Retain start, intermediate and end poses, checking view and clearance at each.

knowledge.title: 可達與可行
knowledge.text: 幾何可達只是任務可行的必要條件之一。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric reachability is only one condition for task feasibility.

knowledge.title: 樣本脈絡
knowledge.text: 取樣前影像與容器識別維持科學證據鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-sampling imagery and container identity preserve scientific context.

quiz.question: 工具端點路徑無碰撞，還要看什麼？
quiz.questionEn: The tool endpoint path is clear. What else must be checked?
options: 只比較起點與終點的工具位置
所有連桿及樣本的掃掠空間
只檢查空載手臂，不納入樣本外形
optionsEn: Compare only initial and final tool positions
Swept space of every link and the sample
Check only the empty arm, excluding the sample shape
quiz.explanation: 碰撞可發生在端點以外的任何部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Collision can occur on parts other than the endpoint.

stages.title: 定位、紀錄與科學驗證
stages.description: 用量測模型與資料流程檢查樣本是否能連回原問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Use measurement models and data flows to check whether samples can be traced to the original question.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 閱讀聲學測距的不確定性
steps.objective: 區分傳播時間、距離與位置估計。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate travel time, range and position estimation.
steps.instruction: 假設聲速c固定、量得雙程時間t，寫出距離r=ct/2。再將時間誤差寫成±Δt，求距離誤差項；全部符號計算，不假裝提供航次數據。
steps.instructionEn: Assume constant sound speed c and measured round-trip time t, giving r=ct/2. Introduce timing error ±Δt and derive the range-error term. Use symbolic calculations without implying expedition data are supplied.
steps.observation: 單一距離只限制在等距位置集合上，不能獨立決定完整位置。
steps.observationEn: One range constrains a set of equal-distance positions, not a complete position.
steps.failure: 漏除以2會把雙程路徑當作單程距離。
steps.failureEn: Omitting division by two treats the round-trip path as one-way range.
steps.check: 寫出r及±cΔt/2，並列出還缺的幾何或量測資訊。
steps.checkEn: Write r and ±cΔt/2, then list missing geometry or measurements.

knowledge.title: 雙程時間
knowledge.text: 發送到回收的時間包含去程與回程。
knowledge.textEn: Transmit-to-return time includes outward and return travel.

knowledge.title: 量測到定位
knowledge.text: 定位需要足夠幾何約束，也受環境模型影響。
knowledge.textEn: Positioning requires sufficient geometric constraints and depends on environmental models.

quiz.question: 用雙程時間求單程距離，為何除以2？
quiz.questionEn: Why divide round-trip travel time by two when finding one-way range?
options: 聲音走了來回兩段
為了把時鐘誤差直接減半
為了補償往返的聲能損失
optionsEn: The sound travels outward and back
To halve the clock error directly
To compensate for acoustic energy lost on the return trip
quiz.explanation: 距離為 r=ct/2；聲速固定時，時間誤差對應距離誤差 ±cΔt/2。雙程時間包含去程與回程，除以2是路徑換算，不是消除時鐘誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: Range is r=ct/2. With fixed sound speed, a time error gives range error ±cΔt/2. Round-trip time includes outward and return paths; dividing by two converts path length, not clock error.

steps.title: 建立水下訊息的確認流程
steps.objective: 在有限通訊下分辨已送出與已收到。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish sent from received under constrained communication.
steps.instruction: 為虛構科學任務畫三個訊息狀態：待送、已送、已確認。给影像摘要加序號與時間；假設一則確認遺失，安排重傳時如何避免重複記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Create pending, sent and acknowledged states for a fictional science message. Add sequence and time to an image summary. Assume an acknowledgment is lost and specify how retransmission avoids duplicate records.
steps.observation: 發送端沒有確認，不等於接收端一定沒收到。
steps.observationEn: Lack of acknowledgment does not prove the receiver got nothing.
steps.failure: 重傳訊息沒有識別碼，可能被當作第二筆觀測。
steps.failureEn: Retransmission without an identifier may be mistaken for a second observation.
steps.check: 用同一序號演練一次確認遺失，接收紀錄只保留一筆邏輯資料。
steps.checkEn: Walk through one lost acknowledgment using the same sequence ID, retaining one logical record.

knowledge.title: 通訊狀態
knowledge.text: 傳送成功、接收成功與應用處理完成並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: Transmission, reception and application processing are distinct successes.

knowledge.title: 冪等處理
knowledge.text: 重複收到同一識別訊息，不應重複產生相同資料事件。
knowledge.textEn: Receiving the same identified message repeatedly should not duplicate its data event.

quiz.question: 確認遺失後重傳，最有用的欄位是？
quiz.questionEn: Which field is most useful when retransmitting after a lost acknowledgment?
options: 每次重傳都產生新的訊息識別碼
只依接收時間判斷是否重複
穩定的訊息識別碼
optionsEn: Generate a new message identifier for every retransmission
Determine duplicates solely from reception time
A stable message identifier
quiz.explanation: 穩定識別有助於區分重傳與新資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable identity distinguishes retransmission from new data.

steps.title: 核對影像、樣本與時間鏈
steps.titleEn: Reconcile image, sample and time records
steps.objective: 讓不同設備資料能對應同一事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Associate records from different devices with one event.
steps.instruction: 自製三筆示意觀測，記錄相機時間、採样時間及樣本編號。刻意讓一台時鐘快2分鐘，計算校正後配對，再保留原始時間與校正說明。
steps.instructionEn: Create three synthetic observations with camera time, sampling time and sample ID. Make one clock two minutes fast, pair events after correction, and retain raw times and the correction note.
steps.observation: 時間一致應指同一基準，而非只看數字接近。
steps.observationEn: Time consistency means a common reference, not merely similar numbers.
steps.failure: 直接覆寫原始時間會失去重建判讀過程的線索。
steps.failureEn: Overwriting raw timestamps removes evidence needed to reconstruct interpretation.
steps.check: 每組配對能追到原始紀錄、時間偏移與樣本識別。
steps.checkEn: Trace each pairing to raw records, clock offset and sample identity.

knowledge.title: 溯源
knowledge.text: 保留原始值與處理步驟，才能重現結果。
knowledge.textEn: Retaining raw values and processing steps enables reproducibility.

knowledge.title: 同步誤差
knowledge.text: 設備時鐘偏差可能造成事件錯配。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offsets can misassociate events.

quiz.question: 發現固定2分鐘偏差，較好的紀錄方法是？
quiz.questionEn: A constant two-minute offset is discovered. What is the better record practice?
options: 忽略偏差只看檔案順序
保留原始時間並另存校正值與方法
直接覆寫所有原始時間
optionsEn: Ignore it and rely on file order
Keep raw time and separately record corrected time and method
Overwrite all raw timestamps
quiz.explanation: 分開保存原始與處理後資料可重建證據鏈。
quiz.explanationEn: Keeping raw and processed data separately preserves the evidence chain.

steps.title: 區分工程驗證與科學驗證
steps.objective: 把平台可用與資料可用分成不同證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate platform readiness from data usability.
steps.instruction: 閱讀WHOI的2022年科學驗證公開說明。將本課程成果分成平台概念、工具功能及資料品質三欄，為每欄寫一項已完成紙上檢查與一項仍需專業實測的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Read WHOI’s public account of 2022 science verification. Sort course outcomes into platform concepts, tool functions and data quality, giving one completed paper check and one question requiring professional measurement in each.
steps.observation: 平台完成某項測試，並不自動證明所有樣本與影像符合科學目的。
steps.observationEn: Passing one platform test does not automatically establish that all samples and images meet scientific goals.
steps.failure: 將公開認證深度當作本課程模型的操作許可，是範圍錯置。
steps.failureEn: Treating a publicly reported depth certification as operating permission for a teaching model is a scope error.
steps.check: 交付三欄驗證表，清楚標示本課程只完成教育分析。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the three-column matrix, clearly identifying the work as educational analysis only.

knowledge.title: 分層驗證
knowledge.text: 系統安全、工具功能與資料適用性需要各自的證據。
knowledge.textEn: System safety, tool function and data fitness need their own evidence.

knowledge.title: 科學可用性
knowledge.text: 資料必須能回答原定問題，才算有用的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Data must answer the intended question to be a useful observation.

quiz.question: 工具動作正常，但樣本標籤混亂，哪項仍未通過？
quiz.questionEn: The tool works, but sample labels are confused. Which aspect remains unverified?
options: 科學資料的可追溯性
工具一定無法移動
所有工程测试均失敗
optionsEn: Scientific-data traceability
The tool necessarily cannot move
Every engineering test has failed
quiz.explanation: 功能正常與資料追溯是不同驗證項。
quiz.explanationEn: Functional operation and data traceability are distinct checks.

courses.title: Toyota Prius 油電混合車
courses.summary: 從公開THS架構出發，用能量帳、理想齒輪、回生與儲能例題理解Prius油電整合，並練習公平比較不同駕駛與世代條件。
courses.summaryEn: Start from the public THS architecture and use energy balances, ideal gearing, regeneration and storage exercises to understand Prius hybrid integration and fair comparisons.
courses.scope: 12道原創概念任務；1997與2003資料僅用於架構及歷史。數值不是任何Prius的ECU標定、電池規格或制動設定；不進行高壓系統拆裝或車輛改裝。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve original conceptual tasks; 1997 and 2003 sources support architecture and history. Values are not Prius ECU calibration, battery specifications or brake settings. No high-voltage disassembly or vehicle modification.

stages.title: 能量邊界與分流原理
stages.description: 先畫能量流，再以功率、時間和理想速度約束檢查單位與邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Map energy flows, then check units and boundaries through power, time and ideal speed constraints.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 界定油電系統的能量邊界
steps.objective: 辨識燃油、電池、車輪功與熱的能量角色。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the energy roles of fuel, battery, wheel work and heat.
steps.instruction: 畫燃油、引擎、發電機、電池、馬達與車輪方塊。以箭頭連接可能能量流，另畫散熱出口；比較行程時保留電池起終儲能，避免把回生當成新能量來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw fuel, engine, generator, battery, motor and wheel blocks. Connect possible energy paths and add heat exits. Retain initial and final battery energy when comparing trips, rather than treating regeneration as a new energy source.
steps.observation: 電池可在不同時刻吸收或釋放能量，其起終差影響比較。
steps.observationEn: The battery can absorb or release energy at different times; its net change affects comparisons.
steps.failure: 只看燃油消耗，卻忽略行程結束時電池少了能量，會偏估效率。
steps.failureEn: Comparing fuel alone while ignoring a depleted battery biases the efficiency assessment.
steps.check: 圖上有能量輸入、儲存、有用輸出與損失四類。
steps.checkEn: Show energy input, storage, useful output and losses.

knowledge.title: 能量守恆
knowledge.text: 能量轉換會改變形式，回生不會憑空創造能量。
knowledge.textEn: Conversion changes energy form; regeneration does not create energy.

knowledge.title: 比較邊界
knowledge.text: 相同行程也要比較電池儲能變化，才有一致邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Even equal trips require battery-energy changes to establish a consistent boundary.

quiz.question: 哪項必須納入兩次行程的公平能量比較？
quiz.questionEn: What must be included for a fair energy comparison between two trips?
options: 只比較燃油消耗，即使電池終點不同
把回生當成系統外新增的能量輸入
電池起點與終點的儲能差
optionsEn: Compare fuel alone even when final battery states differ
Treat regeneration as new energy entering from outside the system
The initial-to-final battery-energy change
quiz.explanation: 電池能量差代表行程使用或留下的儲能。
quiz.explanationEn: Battery-energy change represents stored energy used or retained by the trip.

steps.title: 把功率曲線換成能量
steps.titleEn: Convert a power profile into energy
steps.objective: 用時間積分分清kW與kWh。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate kW and kWh through time integration.
steps.instruction: 使用虛構輪端需求：10kW維持6分鐘、20kW維持3分鐘。各自換算小時後求能量，再畫等能量但不同峰值的另一條曲線。
steps.instructionEn: Use fictional wheel demand of 10 kW for 6 minutes and 20 kW for 3 minutes. Convert time to hours, calculate each energy and sketch another profile with equal energy but a different peak.
steps.observation: 兩段各1kWh，總計2kWh；峰值與累積量不同。
steps.observationEn: Each interval is 1 kWh, totaling 2 kWh; peak and accumulation differ.
steps.failure: 把分鐘直接乘上kW卻標成kWh，會產生60倍單位錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying minutes by kW and labeling the result kWh creates a factor-of-60 error.
steps.check: 每段保留時間換算，總面積為2kWh。
steps.checkEn: Retain each time conversion and obtain a total area of 2 kWh.

knowledge.title: 功率積分
knowledge.text: 固定功率下E=Pt，變動功率則累加分段面積。
knowledge.textEn: For constant power E=Pt; varying power requires summing interval areas.

knowledge.title: 峰值需求
knowledge.text: 相同總能量仍可能需要不同的峰值供能能力。
knowledge.textEn: Equal total energy can require different peak power capability.

quiz.question: 20kW維持3分鐘的能量是多少？
quiz.questionEn: How much energy is 20 kW sustained for 3 minutes?
options: 0.15kWh
1kWh
60kWh
optionsEn: 0.15 kWh
1 kWh
60 kWh
quiz.explanationEn: Three minutes is 0.05 hours; 20×0.05=1.

steps.title: 畫出功率分流的两條路徑
steps.objective: 區分機械傳遞與電力轉換路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish mechanical transmission from electrical conversion.
steps.instruction: 參照Toyota公開系統圖，原創重畫引擎到車輪的機械路徑及經發電機、電力系統、馬達的路徑。再畫電池可接入的位置，不把某次分流比例寫成固定常數。
steps.instructionEn: Using Toyota’s public system diagram as a reference, redraw the engine-to-wheel mechanical path and the path through generator, electrical system and motor. Add the battery connection without treating one power split as a fixed ratio.
steps.observation: 車輪可由不同能量路徑共同驅動，路徑需隨情境辨識。
steps.observationEn: Different energy paths can contribute to wheel drive and must be identified by scenario.
steps.failure: 把所有引擎能量都畫成先進電池，混淆功率分流與純串聯系統。
steps.failureEn: Routing all engine energy through the battery confuses power splitting with a purely series system.
steps.check: 兩條路徑都可從引擎追蹤到車輪，電池為儲能分支。
steps.checkEn: Trace both paths from engine to wheels, showing the battery as storage.

knowledge.title: 分流裝置
knowledge.text: 公開THS架構把引擎功率分配到機械與發電路徑。
knowledge.textEn: The public THS architecture distributes engine power between mechanical and generation paths.

knowledge.title: 轉換損失
knowledge.text: 經過不同轉換次數的路徑，損失與限制不一定相同。
knowledge.textEn: Paths with different conversion stages need not have equal losses or limits.

quiz.question: 哪張圖較符合公開THS分流概念？
quiz.questionEn: Which diagram better matches the public THS power-split concept?
options: 引擎同時可連向車輪及發電機
引擎所有能量都必須先存入電池
引擎僅機械驅動車輪，電機僅用於起動
optionsEn: The engine can connect toward both wheels and generator
All engine energy must first be stored in the battery
The engine only drives mechanically and the electrical machine only starts it
quiz.explanation: 功率分流包含機械路徑，不是所有能量都必經電池。
quiz.explanationEn: Power splitting includes a mechanical path; not all energy must pass through the battery.

steps.title: 閱讀行星齒輪的速度約束
steps.objective: 理解三個轉速並非可任意獨立選擇。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that three rotational speeds are not independent.
steps.instruction: 用理想教學齒輪關係(Ns+Nr)ωc=Nsωs+Nrωr，假設Ns=1、Nr=2，令ωs=0、ωr=3，求ωc。圖上只標太陽輪、環齒輪及行星架，不聲稱這是任一Prius的齒數。
steps.instructionEn: Use the ideal teaching relation (Ns+Nr)ωc=Nsωs+Nrωr with Ns=1, Nr=2, ωs=0 and ωr=3. Solve for ωc. Label sun, ring and carrier without claiming these are Prius tooth counts.
steps.observation: 三項轉速受同一幾何關係約束，結果ωc=2。
steps.observationEn: The three speeds share one kinematic constraint, giving ωc=2.
steps.failure: 把三個轉速各自任意設置，通常無法同時符合齒輪嚙合關係。
steps.failureEn: Arbitrarily choosing all three speeds generally violates the gear constraint.
steps.check: 將結果代回等式，左右兩側皆為6。
steps.checkEn: Substitute the result and obtain 6 on both sides.

knowledge.title: 運動約束
knowledge.text: 齒輪嚙合限制相對運動，不等於固定所有軸的轉速比例。
knowledge.textEn: Gear engagement constrains relative motion without fixing every shaft-speed ratio.

knowledge.title: 模型層級
knowledge.text: 理想速度方程未包含損失、控制器或實際零件限制。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal speed equation excludes losses, controllers and actual component limits.

quiz.question: 此例的行星架轉速ωc為多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the carrier speed ωc in this example?

stages.title: 駕駛情境與儲能變化
stages.description: 使用虛構加速、制動與儲能案例，避免把效率、功率和能量混為一談。
stages.descriptionEn: Use fictional acceleration, braking and storage cases to distinguish efficiency, power and energy.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 核對加速時的瞬時功率帳
steps.objective: 辨識多來源供能與轉換損失。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify multiple power contributions and conversion losses.
steps.instruction: 設教學時刻輪端需30kW，引擎路徑提供18kW、電池經馬達提供15kW。計算總輸入與差額，將差額列為簡化損失項；不要當作車輛效率實測。兩項功率是同一共同邊界的上游輸入，假設邊界內儲能不變且無其他功率流。
steps.instructionEn: At a teaching instant, assume wheel demand is 30 kW, with 18 kW from an engine path and 15 kW from a battery/motor path. Calculate total input and the residual as a simplified loss term, not measured vehicle efficiency. Both inputs cross the same system boundary; assume no change in stored energy inside that boundary and no other power flows.
steps.observation: 供能33kW與輪端30kW之間有3kW差額。
steps.observationEn: There is a 3 kW residual between 33 kW supplied and 30 kW at the wheels.
steps.failure: 把不同介面量到的功率直接當同一位置，會重複計算或漏算損失。
steps.failureEn: Treating power measured at different interfaces as one location can double-count or omit losses.
steps.check: 各功率標清量測邊界，帳目以同一時刻平衡。
steps.checkEn: Label the boundary for each power and balance one instant consistently.

knowledge.title: 瞬時平衡
knowledge.text: 功率帳必須對應相同時刻與清楚的系統邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A power balance requires the same instant and clear system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 殘差判讀
knowledge.text: 帳目差可能代表損失、儲能變化或量測不一致，需先定義模型。
knowledge.textEn: A residual may represent loss, storage change or inconsistent measurement; define the model first.

quiz.question: 在已定義的簡化例題中，損失項是多少？
quiz.questionEn: In this defined simplified example, what is the loss term?
options: 63kW
3kW
12kW
optionsEn: 63 kW
3 kW
12 kW

steps.title: 比較效率點與整體油耗
steps.titleEn: Compare operating efficiency with trip fuel use
steps.objective: 避免把引擎最佳效率點當作永遠可用的答案。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating an engine’s best-efficiency point as always available.
steps.instruction: 自畫兩個假設運轉點：A的需求10、效率0.25，B的需求20、效率0.40。比較輸入需求P/η，再列出多餘能量是否可儲存及何時需要它；不使用OEM效率圖。
steps.instructionEn: Invent operating points A with output 10 and efficiency 0.25, and B with output 20 and efficiency 0.40. Compare input P/η, then ask whether surplus energy can be stored and when it is needed. Use no OEM efficiency map.
steps.observation: 效率較高的B，其瞬時輸入仍可能較大。
steps.observationEn: The more efficient point B can still have higher instantaneous input.
steps.failure: 只看效率百分比而忽略需求與儲能限制，會選錯比較邊界。
steps.failureEn: Looking only at efficiency percentage ignores demand and storage constraints.
steps.check: 列出A輸入40、B輸入50，以及不能直接比較全程油耗的原因。
steps.checkEn: Report inputs of 40 and 50 and explain why they do not directly compare trip fuel use.

knowledge.title: 效率定義
knowledge.text: 效率是有用輸出與輸入的比值，不是輸入的絕對大小。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency is useful output divided by input, not the absolute input magnitude.

knowledge.title: 時間協調
knowledge.text: 混合動力可跨時間安排能量，但仍受儲能與損失限制。
knowledge.textEn: A hybrid can coordinate energy over time, subject to storage and loss constraints.

quiz.question: 較高效率點一定消耗較少瞬時輸入嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a higher-efficiency point always use less instantaneous input?
options: 不一定，還要看輸出需求
一定，只要效率百分比較高
只要兩點的時間相同就一定較少
optionsEn: No; output demand also matters
Yes, whenever its efficiency percentage is higher
Yes, as long as both points last equally long
quiz.explanation: 輸入等於輸出除以效率，兩個量都影響結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Input equals output divided by efficiency, so both quantities matter.

steps.title: 分析回生制動的能量上限
steps.titleEn: Analyze an energy limit for regeneration
steps.objective: 區分可回收動能與实际儲存能量。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish recoverable kinetic energy from stored energy.
steps.instruction: 以E=mv²/2比較同質量在v與2v時的動能。假設某次減速有100教學能量單位、總回收比例0.6，求儲存與未回收部分；這不是真車制動設定。
steps.instructionEn: Use E=mv²/2 to compare kinetic energy at v and 2v for equal mass. For a fictional slowdown with 100 energy units and a total recovery fraction of 0.6, calculate stored and unrecovered portions. This is not a brake setting.
steps.observation: 速度加倍使動能成4倍；例題只能存回60單位。
steps.observationEn: Doubling speed quadruples kinetic energy; the example stores only 60 units.
steps.failure: 把每次制動的全部動能都算入電池，忽略轉換與接收限制。
steps.failureEn: Counting all braking energy as battery storage ignores conversion and acceptance limits.
steps.check: 能量帳為60回收加40未回收，且不超過100。
steps.checkEn: Show 60 recovered plus 40 unrecovered, never exceeding 100.

knowledge.title: 動能平方律
knowledge.text: 質量固定時，動能與速度平方成正比。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed mass, kinetic energy is proportional to speed squared.

knowledge.title: 回收限制
knowledge.text: 電池接收能力、系統損失與行駛情境限制回生。
knowledge.textEn: Battery acceptance, system losses and driving conditions limit regeneration.

quiz.question: 同質量速度加倍，動能變為多少倍？
quiz.questionEn: For the same mass, doubling speed multiplies kinetic energy by what?
options: 2倍
4倍
quiz.explanation: 動能包含v²項。
quiz.explanationEn: Kinetic energy contains v².

steps.title: 追蹤電池儲能狀態
steps.objective: 把充放電事件排成可核對的能量序列。
steps.objectiveEn: Arrange charge/discharge events into an auditable energy sequence.
steps.instruction: 假設可用儲能窗10單位，起始6；先放出2，再接收1.2。計算各時刻存量並對照0至10示意範圍；不把百分比當成真實電池電壓。
steps.instructionEn: Assume a usable 10-unit storage window starting at 6. Discharge 2, then receive 1.2. Compute each state within the teaching range 0–10, without equating a percentage to actual battery voltage.
steps.observation: 最終為5.2，與起點差−0.8。
steps.observationEn: The final state is 5.2, a change of −0.8 from the start.
steps.failure: 用總充電量當最終存量，會漏掉初始條件與放電。
steps.failureEn: Using total charge received as final stored energy omits the initial state and discharge.
steps.check: 列出6→4→5.2，能量增減與每個事件一致。
steps.checkEn: Show 6→4→5.2 with changes matching each event.

knowledge.title: 狀態量
knowledge.text: 儲能取決於初始狀態與之後累積的能量變化。
knowledge.textEn: Stored energy depends on the initial state and accumulated changes.

knowledge.title: 估計與量測
knowledge.text: 電池狀態估計不能僅靠任意單一百分比推回完整物理狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A battery-state estimate cannot be reconstructed fully from an arbitrary percentage alone.

quiz.question: 例題行程結束，比起點少多少儲能？
quiz.questionEn: How much stored energy is lost relative to the start in this example?
options: 5.2單位
0.8單位
1.2單位
optionsEn: 5.2 units
0.8 units
1.2 units

stages.title: 熱、功能與比較證據
stages.description: 從熱帳與回生受限情境走向條件一致、版本明確的工程比較。
stages.descriptionEn: Move from heat balance and limited regeneration to comparisons with matched conditions and explicit versions.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 建立損失到散熱的路徑
steps.objective: 把電力與機械損失連到熱負荷。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect electrical and mechanical losses to heat loads.
steps.instruction: 在原創能量圖上標出馬達、電力轉換與電池的假設損失位置。使用簡化熱帳：產熱8單位、散熱5單位，標示內能增加方向；不指定真車冷卻液或溫度。
steps.instructionEn: Mark hypothetical motor, power-conversion and battery losses on your energy diagram. Use a simplified heat balance with 8 units generated and 5 removed, indicating the direction of internal-energy change. Specify no vehicle coolant or temperature.
steps.observation: 持續產熱大於散熱時，儲存熱能會增加。
steps.observationEn: Stored thermal energy increases when generation persistently exceeds removal.
steps.failure: 只查瞬時電功率而忽略時間累積，可能漏掉熱負荷。
steps.failureEn: Checking instantaneous electrical power alone can miss accumulated thermal loading.
steps.check: 寫出+3單位內能變化，並指出還缺熱容量才能估溫升。
steps.checkEn: Record +3 units of internal-energy change and identify heat capacity as needed for temperature rise.

knowledge.title: 熱平衡
knowledge.text: 產熱、散熱與儲熱需同時納入。
knowledge.textEn: Generation, removal and storage all belong in the heat balance.

knowledge.title: 模型不足
knowledge.text: 沒有熱容量與邊界條件，不能由能量差直接得溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Without heat capacity and boundary conditions, an energy difference does not determine temperature.

quiz.question: 產熱8、散熱5，能否直接知道溫度？
quiz.questionEn: With generation 8 and removal 5, can temperature be known directly?
options: 不能，尚需熱容量等條件
能，必定是3°C
能，必定維持不變
optionsEn: No; heat capacity and other conditions are needed
Yes, it must be 3°C
Yes, it must stay unchanged
quiz.explanation: 能量差與溫度差的單位和意義不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy difference and temperature difference have different units and meanings.

steps.title: 分析回生受限時的制動需求
steps.titleEn: Analyze braking demand when regeneration is limited
steps.objective: 分開處理車輛減速需求與能量回收能力。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate required deceleration from energy-recovery capability.
steps.instruction: 在紙上列出假設減速需求與可用回生兩欄。安排一個電池暫不能接收能量的情境，指出總制動功能仍需由合格整車系統滿足；僅做功能分析，不改制動控制。
steps.instructionEn: On paper, list hypothetical deceleration demand and available regeneration. Introduce a battery-unavailable-for-charging scenario and identify that overall braking must still be met by the qualified vehicle system. Analyze functions only; do not alter brake control.
steps.observation: 回生降低不代表駕駛的減速需求同時消失。
steps.observationEn: Reduced regeneration does not remove the driver’s braking demand.
steps.failure: 把回收能量視為唯一制動能力，會混淆安全功能與效率功能。
steps.failureEn: Treating recovery as the sole braking capability confuses safety and efficiency functions.
steps.check: 列出能量回收、總減速及狀態提示三項不同需求。
steps.checkEn: List energy recovery, total deceleration and status indication as distinct requirements.

knowledge.title: 功能協調
knowledge.text: 多種制動作用需在整車層級協調驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Different braking contributions require vehicle-level coordination and verification.

knowledge.title: 受限狀態
knowledge.text: 能量儲存的限制可能改變回收能力。
knowledge.textEn: Storage constraints can change recovery capability.

quiz.question: 電池不能接收回生能量時，仍須满足什麼？
quiz.questionEn: When the battery cannot accept regenerated energy, what remains necessary?
options: 保持與電池可充電時完全相同的回收量
把回生能力當成唯一總制動需求
整車規定的減速功能
optionsEn: Maintain exactly the same recovery as when charging was available
Treat regeneration capability as the sole overall braking requirement
The vehicle’s required deceleration function
quiz.explanation: 效率功能受限不能取代總制動需求。
quiz.explanationEn: A recovery limitation does not replace the overall braking requirement.

steps.title: 設計公平的行程比較
steps.objective: 控制影響油耗比較的條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Control conditions that affect fuel-use comparisons.
steps.instruction: 自製兩次虛構行程紀錄欄位：距離、速度歷程、坡度、載重、環境與電池起終狀態。找出其中一項不一致時應如何限制結論；不自填真實油耗數據。
steps.instructionEn: Create fields for two fictional trips: distance, speed profile, grade, payload, environment and initial/final battery state. Explain how a mismatch in one field limits conclusions, without inventing measured fuel data.
steps.observation: 相同距離並不保证相同交通、載荷或能量邊界。
steps.observationEn: Equal distance does not guarantee equal traffic, load or energy boundaries.
steps.failure: 把不同測試循環的公開數字直接排名，可能比較的是條件而非技術。
steps.failureEn: Ranking numbers from different test cycles may compare conditions rather than technology.
steps.check: 列出至少三個需一致的條件及一項仍存在的不確定性。
steps.checkEn: List at least three conditions to match and one remaining uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 實驗控制
knowledge.text: 比較需要限定變動因素，並記錄無法控制的因素。
knowledge.textEn: Comparison requires limiting changing factors and recording uncontrolled ones.

knowledge.title: 重複性
knowledge.text: 單次結果不足以描述變動範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A single result does not describe variability.

quiz.question: 兩次行程距離相同，就能直接比較技術效率嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Are equal trip distances enough to compare technical efficiency directly?
options: 只要車款名稱相同就能
不能，還需匹配其他條件與能量邊界
能，距離是唯一因素
optionsEn: Only matching the model name is needed
No; other conditions and energy boundaries must match
Yes; distance is the only factor
quiz.explanation: 公平比較涉及負载、速度、環境與儲能狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: A fair comparison involves load, speed, environment and stored-energy state.

steps.title: 交付分世代的油電證據圖
steps.titleEn: Deliver a generation-specific hybrid evidence map
steps.objective: 區分跨世代原理與某一車型的具體實作。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate cross-generation principles from model-specific implementation.
steps.instruction: 把1997公開THS架構與2003 THS II發表放在时间線。將本課程的能量守恆、分流、回生和熱帳標為可轉移原理；把硬體數值及控制標定列為需按年份查證。
steps.instructionEn: Place the 1997 public THS architecture and 2003 THS II announcement on a timeline. Mark conservation, power splitting, regeneration and heat balance as transferable principles; mark hardware values and control calibration for model-year verification.
steps.observation: 名字延續不代表每代的電池、電機與控制設定相同。
steps.observationEn: A continuing model name does not mean identical batteries, machines or controls across generations.
steps.failure: 將一代技術資料與另一代型號混在同一張表而未標年分，會造成錯引。
steps.failureEn: Mixing one generation’s technical data with another model without dates creates misattribution.
steps.check: 提交有來源年份、假設標記與待查欄位的系統圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a system map with source years, assumption labels and open verification fields.

knowledge.title: 技術傳承
knowledge.text: 物理原理可延續，工程實作仍會演進。
knowledge.textEn: Physical principles can persist while implementation evolves.

knowledge.title: 版本溯源
knowledge.text: 年份、市場與產品版本是技術資料的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Year, market and product revision are part of technical provenance.

quiz.question: 閱讀不同世代Prius資料，哪種做法最好？
quiz.questionEn: What is the best practice when reading different Prius generations?
options: 標明年份與版本再比較相同功能
所有資料合併為一套固定參數
以較新的照片證明舊規格
optionsEn: Mark year and revision before comparing the same function
Merge all data into one fixed parameter set
Use a newer photo to prove an older specification
quiz.explanation: 版本明確，才不會將架構原理誤當固定實作。
quiz.explanationEn: Explicit versions prevent confusing architectural principles with fixed implementation.

courses.title: Landsat 地球觀測計畫
courses.summary: 以Landsat 8作主要儀器例子，學習軌道、波段、DN換算、品質遮罩與時間序列，區分原始觀測、處理结果及環境推論。
courses.summaryEn: Use Landsat 8 as the main instrument example to study orbit, bands, DN conversion, quality masks and time series, separating observations, processing and environmental inference.
courses.scope: 12道原創遙測入門任務；課程沒有預載實景或實測表格。小算例係數為教學假設；實際分析需自行取得資料及其版本相符的中繼資料，不把单一衛星規格套用所有世代。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve original introductory remote-sensing tasks, without preloaded scenes or measured tables. Small-example coefficients are hypothetical. Actual analysis requires acquired data and matching metadata; one satellite’s specifications do not apply to every generation.

stages.title: 觀測設計與取樣尺度
stages.description: 從地表問題選擇時間、波段和空間尺度，再區分取樣與顯示。
stages.descriptionEn: Choose time, bands and spatial scale from the land question, then separate sampling from display.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 把地表問題轉成觀測需求
steps.titleEn: Translate a land question into observation requirements
steps.objective: 為植被比較選定波段、時段與品質條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose bands, periods and quality conditions for a vegetation comparison.
steps.instruction: 設定虛構問題：同一地區兩個時段的植被是否改變？列出紅光、近紅外、可比日期、地理範圍及雲遮狀態；先定義資料需求，不把網站示意圖當作已下載影像。
steps.instructionEn: Set a fictional question: did vegetation change between two periods in one area? List red and near-infrared bands, comparable dates, geographic extent and cloud status. Define data requirements without treating site diagrams as downloaded imagery.
steps.observation: 漂亮彩圖不代表兩期具備相同觀測條件。
steps.observationEn: An attractive color image does not establish comparable conditions between dates.
steps.failure: 不同季節或雲遮的差異可能被錯認為地表變化。
steps.failureEn: Seasonal or cloud differences can be mistaken for surface change.
steps.check: 每項比較需求都有資料欄位與排除條件。
steps.checkEn: Give each comparison requirement a data field and an exclusion condition.

knowledge.title: 觀測設計
knowledge.text: 研究問題決定時間、波段與空間範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The question determines time, bands and spatial extent.

knowledge.title: 可比性
knowledge.text: 比較之前需確認資料代表相近的觀測情境。
knowledge.textEn: Comparison first requires checking that observations represent compatible conditions.

quiz.question: 要比較植被變化，哪組條件較完整？
quiz.questionEn: Which set is more complete for comparing vegetation change?
options: 使用同一衛星便不需核對季節與雲
像元間距相同便不需核對地點與日期
同地範圍、可比時段、紅光/NIR與雲狀態
optionsEn: Use the same satellite without checking season or cloud
Match pixel spacing without checking location or date
Same area, comparable periods, red/NIR and cloud status
quiz.explanation: 資料的可比性比展示色彩更接近科學問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Data comparability addresses the scientific question more directly than display colors.

steps.title: 區分繞行週期與重訪週期
steps.titleEn: Distinguish orbital period from repeat cycle
steps.objective: 避免把繞地球一圈當作回到同一觀測軌跡。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating one orbit with a repeat of the same observation track.
steps.instruction: 依USGS對Landsat 8的介紹，分別記錄約99分鐘繞行與16日重複週期。畫旋轉地球下的相鄰地面軌跡，說明為何兩種時間不能互換；不將數字套用全部Landsat世代。
steps.instructionEn: From USGS’s Landsat 8 overview, separately record the approximately 99-minute orbit and 16-day repeat cycle. Sketch adjacent tracks over a rotating Earth and explain why the intervals differ. Do not apply them to every Landsat generation.
steps.observation: 衛星每圈經過不同地面經度，還需考慮地球自轉。
steps.observationEn: Successive orbits cross different ground longitudes because Earth rotates.
steps.failure: 把99分鐘說成同一地點必定有新影像，混淆軌道與覆盖。
steps.failureEn: Claiming a new image of the same site every 99 minutes confuses orbit with coverage.
steps.check: 筆記分開列出兩種週期、對應事件及Landsat 8限定。
steps.checkEn: Record both intervals, their events and the Landsat 8 limitation.

knowledge.title: 地面軌跡
knowledge.text: 軌道運動與地球自轉共同決定地面投影。
knowledge.textEn: Orbital motion and Earth’s rotation jointly determine the ground projection.

knowledge.title: 重訪與可用
knowledge.text: 軌跡重訪也不保證無雲或符合研究需求。
knowledge.textEn: A repeated track does not guarantee cloud-free or suitable data.

quiz.question: Landsat 8的99分鐘與16日分别描述什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What do Landsat 8’s 99 minutes and 16 days describe?
options: 同地重訪與繞行一圈，順序與前項相反
繞行一圈與地面軌跡重複
資料處理時間與感測器曝光週期
optionsEn: Site revisit and one orbit, in the reverse order
One orbit and ground-track repetition
Data processing duration and sensor exposure period
quiz.explanation: 不同週期對應不同幾何事件。
quiz.explanationEn: The intervals describe different geometric events.

steps.title: 閱讀多光譜波段的物理用途
steps.titleEn: Read the physical purposes of spectral bands
steps.objective: 把感測波段與可觀察現象對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate spectral bands to observable phenomena.
steps.instruction: 畫可見光、近紅外、短波紅外及熱紅外的概念區帶。將反射太陽光與熱放射分成兩類，再列植被、水分及熱狀態需要哪些額外判讀條件。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch conceptual visible, near-infrared, shortwave-infrared and thermal-infrared regions. Separate reflected sunlight from thermal emission, then list additional interpretation conditions for vegetation, moisture and thermal state.
steps.observation: 不同波段不是相同照片換顏色，而是不同的光譜量測。
steps.observationEn: Bands are different spectral measurements, not the same photo recolored.
steps.failure: 把熱紅外亮度直接當成可見光顏色，會用錯物理解釋。
steps.failureEn: Interpreting thermal-infrared brightness as visible color applies the wrong physics.
steps.check: 至少把一個反射波段與一個熱波段對應到各自觀測機制。
steps.checkEn: Associate at least one reflected and one thermal band with their mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 光譜選擇
knowledge.text: 感測器只量到其波段響應範圍內的資訊。
knowledge.textEn: A sensor measures information within its spectral response range.

knowledge.title: 顯示與量測
knowledge.text: 偽彩色把波段映射成螢幕色彩，不等於肉眼所見。
knowledge.textEn: False color maps bands to screen colors and need not match human vision.

quiz.question: 偽彩色中的紅色區域，必定是地表真實紅色嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Must a red area in a false-color image be physically red?
options: 不一定，要查波段到色彩的映射
一定，每個顯示通道都等於相同的可見光顏色
只要像元更密，就可忽略波段映射
optionsEn: No; inspect the band-to-color mapping
Yes; each display channel always equals the corresponding visible color
A denser pixel grid makes band mapping irrelevant
quiz.explanation: 顯示通道由使用者或產品設定。
quiz.explanationEn: Display channels are set by the user or product.

steps.title: 分開像元間距與可辨細節
steps.titleEn: Separate pixel spacing from resolved detail
steps.objective: 理解取樣、混合像元與重取樣的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand sampling, mixed pixels and resampling.
steps.instruction: 在紙上畫30m網格與一條10m寬的假設河道，標出被河道和岸地共同占據的格子。再把網格細分成10m顯示格，指出哪些資訊仍無法由插值新增。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a 30 m grid and a hypothetical 10 m-wide river. Mark cells mixing water and banks, then subdivide the display grid to 10 m and identify information that interpolation cannot create.
steps.observation: 更密的顯示格並不自動增加原始感測細節。
steps.observationEn: A denser display grid does not automatically add original sensor detail.
steps.failure: 把輸出像元變小當作感測器解析度變高，會誇大辨識能力。
steps.failureEn: Treating smaller output pixels as better sensor resolution overstates resolving ability.
steps.check: 指出一個混合像元，並註明重取樣只改資料表示。
steps.checkEn: Identify a mixed pixel and state that resampling changes representation.

knowledge.title: 混合像元
knowledge.text: 一個像元可能同時包含多種地表。
knowledge.textEn: One pixel may contain several surface types.

knowledge.title: 取樣限制
knowledge.text: 後處理不能無條件恢復原始未量到的高頻資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Post-processing cannot unconditionally recover spatial information never measured.

quiz.question: 30m影像重取樣成10m格，能保證什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Resampling a 30 m image to a 10 m grid guarantees what?
options: 新增真實10m感測細節
所有混合像元消失
輸出格網間距變小
optionsEn: New genuine 10 m sensor detail
Removal of all mixed pixels
Smaller output-grid spacing
quiz.explanation: 格網間距與實際可辨識細節不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Grid spacing differs from genuinely resolved detail.

stages.title: 產品識別與物理換算
stages.description: 使用來源中的換算形式，搭配明示教學值與待填場景卡。
stages.descriptionEn: Use conversion forms from the references with explicit teaching values and pending scene cards.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 核對場景與中繼資料版本
steps.objective: 在轉換數值前確認資料產品與係數來源。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm product and coefficient identity before conversion.
steps.instruction: 建立一張空白場景卡，欄位含衛星、感測器、日期、產品層級、Collection、波段與中繼資料檔名。若自行從USGS取得資料，逐項抄錄；未取得時標為待填，不虛構場景編號。
steps.instructionEn: Create a blank scene card with satellite, sensor, date, product level, collection, band and metadata filename. If you obtain USGS data, transcribe them; otherwise mark fields pending rather than inventing a scene ID.
steps.observation: 相同波段號碼在不同產品世代可能不代表相同用途。
steps.observationEn: The same band number can have different meaning across product generations.
steps.failure: 拿另一場景或不同產品層級的係數換算，會失去可追溯性。
steps.failureEn: Using coefficients from another scene or product level breaks traceability.
steps.check: 每項係數能連回同一產品的中繼資料，未知項明示。
steps.checkEn: Trace each coefficient to the same product’s metadata and mark unknowns.

knowledge.title: 產品層級
knowledge.text: 原始量化值與不同處理產品有不同解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Quantized values and differently processed products have different interpretations.

knowledge.title: 參數溯源
knowledge.text: 係數、版本與資料日期共同決定換算適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Coefficients, revision and date jointly determine conversion applicability.

quiz.question: 進行DN換算前，哪項最應先確認？
quiz.questionEn: Before converting DN, what should be confirmed first?
options: 任意相鄰日期的係數都可直接沿用
係數屬於同一產品與波段
所有波段共用同一係數即可
optionsEn: Coefficients from any nearby date can be reused directly
Coefficients belong to the same product and band
One coefficient set can be used for all bands
quiz.explanation: 正確公式搭配錯誤係數仍會得到錯誤結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A correct formula with wrong coefficients still gives a wrong result.

steps.title: 用教學係數換算輻亮度
steps.objective: 把DN與有物理單位的輻亮度分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish DN from radiance with physical units.
steps.instruction: 使用USGS的線性形式L=M×DN+A，另設教學係數M=0.02、A=−1、DN=100，計算L。明寫係數虛構，實景必須使用該產品MTL檔的係數。
steps.instructionEn: Use the USGS linear form L=M×DN+A with invented teaching coefficients M=0.02, A=−1 and DN=100. Compute L and label the coefficients fictional; real scenes require their product’s MTL coefficients.
steps.observation: 結果為1個相應輻亮度單位，不能把DN=100直接標作輻亮度。
steps.observationEn: The result is 1 in corresponding radiance units; DN=100 is not itself radiance.
steps.failure: 漏掉加法項A，會得到不同且帶系統偏差的結果。
steps.failureEn: Omitting additive term A produces a systematic difference.
steps.check: 保留乘法、加法與單位標記，且係數標為教學假設。
steps.checkEn: Retain multiplication, addition and units, with coefficients marked as assumptions.

knowledge.title: 線性縮放
knowledge.text: 斜率與截距共同把量化值對應到物理量。
knowledge.textEn: Slope and intercept jointly map a quantized value to a physical quantity.

knowledge.title: 資料解釋
knowledge.text: 儲存位元數不等於物理單位或精確度。
knowledge.textEn: Storage bit depth is not a physical unit or an accuracy guarantee.

quiz.question: 此例L=0.02×100−1等於多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is L=0.02×100−1 in this example?
quiz.explanation: 乘法得2，再加−1得1。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplication gives 2; adding −1 gives 1.

steps.title: 套用太陽角的反射率修正
steps.objective: 區分未修正與太陽角修正的TOA反射率。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate uncorrected and solar-angle-corrected TOA reflectance.
steps.instruction: 在紙上設未修正反射率ρ′=0.2、太陽高度30°，用ρ=ρ′/sin(θ)求值。另畫高度角與天頂角互補的圖；不把TOA反射率稱為地表反射率。
steps.instructionEn: Assume uncorrected reflectance ρ′=0.2 and solar elevation 30°, then apply ρ=ρ′/sin(θ). Sketch complementary elevation and zenith angles. Do not label TOA reflectance as surface reflectance.
steps.observation: 本例sin30°=0.5，修正後為0.4。
steps.observationEn: Here sin30°=0.5, giving corrected reflectance 0.4.
steps.failure: 混用高度角的cos與天頂角的sin，會套錯幾何。
steps.failureEn: Using cosine of elevation or sine of zenith applies the wrong geometry.
steps.check: 同時標明角度定義、計算結果與TOA層級。
steps.checkEn: State the angle definition, result and TOA product level.

knowledge.title: 角度定義
knowledge.text: 太陽高度與天頂角互補，公式必須對應使用。
knowledge.textEn: Solar elevation and zenith are complementary, so formulas must match definitions.

knowledge.title: 大氣層頂
knowledge.text: 太陽角修正不等於已消除所有大氣影響。
knowledge.textEn: Solar-angle correction does not remove every atmospheric effect.

quiz.question: 修正太陽高度後，能否直接稱為地表反射率？
quiz.questionEn: After solar-elevation correction, can the result be called surface reflectance directly?
options: 能，太陽角修正已消除所有大氣影響
能，只要另外用了相同雲遮罩
不能，仍是TOA層級
optionsEn: Yes; solar-angle correction removes every atmospheric effect
Yes, provided the same cloud mask is also used
No; it remains TOA reflectance
quiz.explanation: 幾何修正與大氣校正不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric correction differs from atmospheric correction.

steps.title: 分辨亮溫與地表溫度
steps.titleEn: Distinguish brightness temperature from surface temperature
steps.objective: 理解熱波段換算結果的物理層級。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the physical level of a thermal-band conversion.
steps.instruction: 畫熱放射從地表到感測器的路徑，列出放射率與大氣影響。閱讀USGS亮溫公式所需K1、K2及輻亮度欄位，建立空白計算表；無實景係數時不產生真實溫度地圖。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch thermal radiation traveling from surface to sensor and list emissivity and atmospheric effects. Identify K1, K2 and radiance required by the USGS brightness-temperature formula, creating a blank worksheet rather than a real temperature map without scene coefficients.
steps.observation: 感測器亮溫不直接等於每一地物的實際表面溫度。
steps.observationEn: Sensor brightness temperature is not automatically the physical temperature of every surface.
steps.failure: 忽略放射率或把K當°C，會造成不同類型的錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring emissivity or treating kelvin as Celsius creates different errors.
steps.check: 表格清楚標K、產品層級及需另處理的環境因素。
steps.checkEn: Label kelvin, product level and environmental factors requiring further treatment.

knowledge.title: 亮溫
knowledge.text: 亮溫以輻射模型表達觀測到的熱訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Brightness temperature expresses an observed thermal signal through a radiative model.

knowledge.title: 放射率
knowledge.text: 不同表面的放射特性會影響溫度反推。
knowledge.textEn: Surface emission properties affect temperature inference.

quiz.question: 熱波段換出的亮溫要用於地表研究，還需注意什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What still matters when using thermal brightness temperature for surface studies?
options: 只需從K值扣273.15就成為地表溫度
放射率、大氣與產品處理層級
同一熱波段的所有地物可共用相同放射特性
optionsEn: Only subtract 273.15 from kelvin to obtain surface temperature
Emissivity, atmosphere and product-processing level
Every surface in one thermal band has the same emission properties
quiz.explanation: 亮溫與地表溫度具有不同假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Brightness and surface temperature involve different assumptions.

stages.title: 品質、對準與變化判讀
stages.description: 將遮罩、幾何、指標及跨感測器限制帶入可重現的比較。
stages.descriptionEn: Include masks, geometry, indices and cross-sensor limitations in reproducible comparisons.
stages.route: 原創概念學習路線；工序編號是教學順序，不是原廠連續製造或操作程序。
stages.routeEn: An original conceptual learning route; numbering indicates teaching order, not a continuous manufacturer production or operating procedure.

steps.title: 先遮罩再解讀有效像元
steps.objective: 把雲、缺值與飽和等品質狀態保留在分析中。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain quality states such as cloud, missing data and saturation.
steps.instruction: 自製一個3×3示意格，明確指定兩格雲、一格缺值，其餘為假設反射率。只對有效格計算平均，並記錄被排除數；真實產品須查其QA定義。
steps.instructionEn: Create a synthetic 3×3 grid with two cloud cells, one missing cell and assumed reflectance elsewhere. Average only valid cells and record exclusions; real products require their QA definitions.
steps.observation: 有效像元數為6，不是9。
steps.observationEn: The valid-pixel count is 6, not 9.
steps.failure: 把缺值當零加入平均，會人為降低結果。
steps.failureEn: Averaging missing data as zero artificially lowers the result.
steps.check: 交付有效遮罩、平均分母與排除理由。
steps.checkEn: Provide the validity mask, averaging denominator and exclusion reasons.

knowledge.title: 品質旗標
knowledge.text: 品質資訊屬於資料解釋的一部分，而非可忽略附件。
knowledge.textEn: Quality information is part of data interpretation, not optional decoration.

knowledge.title: 缺值語意
knowledge.text: 沒有觀測不等於觀測值為零。
knowledge.textEn: No observation is not an observed zero.

quiz.question: 9格中2格雲、1格缺值，平均分母應是多少？
quiz.questionEn: With 2 cloudy and 1 missing cell among 9, what is the averaging denominator?
quiz.explanation: 排除三個無效觀測後剩六格。
quiz.explanationEn: Excluding three invalid observations leaves six.

steps.title: 核對兩期影像的幾何對準
steps.objective: 避免把位置錯位誤判為地表改變。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid interpreting misregistration as surface change.
steps.instruction: 畫兩張相同地物邊界的方格圖，讓第二張故意位移一格。做逐格差異標記，再恢復對準比較；說明真實資料還需核對投影、格網與重取樣方法。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two grid maps of identical boundaries and shift the second by one cell. Mark cellwise differences, then realign and compare. Explain that real data also require projection, grid and resampling checks.
steps.observation: 位移能在邊緣製造一圈假變化。
steps.observationEn: A shift can create a band of false change around boundaries.
steps.failure: 只檢查日期相近，卻未核對座標系，會留下空間錯配。
steps.failureEn: Checking similar dates without coordinate systems leaves spatial mismatch.
steps.check: 列出對準前後差異，並標示共同格網基準。
steps.checkEn: Report differences before and after alignment and label the shared grid.

knowledge.title: 配準
knowledge.text: 比較像元需要代表相同或可對應的地面位置。
knowledge.textEn: Compared pixels must represent the same or corresponding ground locations.

knowledge.title: 邊緣敏感性
knowledge.text: 地物邊界對小位移通常比均勻區域更敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Boundaries are usually more sensitive to small shifts than uniform areas.

quiz.question: 差異只集中在所有地物邊緣，優先檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Differences cluster around every boundary. What should be checked first?
